thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate for org 'cobalt-partners' — 5xx spike on inference-prod (latency & error budget). P97 latency 2.3s -> 6.9s, 5xx rate 18% in last 3m. Paging on-call: @maya

maya (on-call): Ack. Looking.

maya (on-call): Quick triage: errors ramped up ~10:14 UTC. Top traces show overloaded model-worker pool for model 'redwood-v1-small' in us-west-2 tied to requests from `org:cobalt-partners` (saw ~12k req/min, normally ~1.2k).

ian (sre): If it's a single-org spike, we should throttle at org level first. Rolling global mitigations will hurt others.

maya (on-call): Agreed. Plan: 1) Emergency per-org rate limit to 15 qps for cobalt, 2) disable streaming for that org, 3) route to fallback smaller model for excess requests, 4) notify CS + customer. I'll run the admin command.

maya (on-call): Running:
```
rwdctl org rate set --org cobalt-partners --max-qps 15 --window 1m --duration 20m --reason "emergency spike"
```

ops-bot: command accepted. queued -> policy-service.

lee (eng-runtime): I pushed a policy to policy-service: id=rl-9834; applied to org:cobalt-partners; scope=prod; enforced=true.

ops-bot: policy rl-9834 applied to 12 nodes (us-west-2). Enforcement started.

maya (on-call): Also disabling streaming for the org:
```
rwdctl org config update --org cobalt-partners --set disable_streaming=true
```

ash (support): Notifying Cobalt CS/AE now. Drafting message: "We're throttling requests briefly due to a high-volume job; we're applying safeguards. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."

sam (cs): Sent at 10:20 UTC to their SRE distribution list. They ack'd, asking for ETA.

jordan (pm): Any SLA/credits implications? need to loop finance if >30m.

ian (sre): Current mitigation in effect. Error rate dropping to 2% in 3m window, p95 latency back to 1.1s. Recommend keep 20m window then reassess.

maya (on-call): Monitoring dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/teams/ingress?org=cobalt-partners span=15m

maya (on-call): Also added a temporary quota rule to limit tokens per minute:
```
rwdctl org quota update --org cobalt-partners --tokens-per-minute 5000 --duration 30m --note "emergency limit"
```

ops-bot: quota update successful -> quota-id=q-7721.

lee (eng-runtime): Fallback model switch for requests beyond quota: routing to `redwood-v1-micro` for this org is active.

maya (on-call): Logging note: created incident ticket INC-4921; linked to runbook "org-rate-spike". Triage note: likely customer-side batch or misconfigured client.

ash (support): Cobalt confirms it's a mis-scheduled retry job — will throttle on their side. They request an IP whitelist / short window to finish, asking for temporary increase.

maya (on-call): We can do a short manual bump: `rwdctl org rate set --org cobalt-partners --max-qps 80 --duration 5m --note "customer finish window"` but only after they confirm low risk.

sam (cs): They requested now and agree to stay below 80 qps and watch. They also agreed to stop the job after.

maya (on-call): Applying bump.

```
rwdctl org rate set --org cobalt-partners --max-qps 80 --duration 5m --reason "customer finish window"
```

ops-bot: policy rl-9841 applied. window=5m.

ian (sre): Watching metrics — slight spike but not impacting global cluster. No new errors.

maya (on-call): Bump expired, reverted to rl-9834 limits. Confirmed by ops-bot.

ops-bot: policy rl-9841 expired; enforced policy rl-9834 active.

jordan (pm): Good. Let's capture RCA later. For now: customer impact minimal, CS handled comms. Please add notes about credits decision (likely none <30m).

maya (on-call): Marking incident resolved. last_action: per-org rate limit + quota + temporary model fallback + 5m customer finish window. Duration ~42m total. Closing incident INC-4921.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4921 -> resolved by maya (on-call). Duration 00:42:16. :white_check_mark: 

ash (support): Will follow up with Cobalt for post-mortem and ask them to coordinate scheduling change.

lee (eng-runtime): Filed a follow-up PR to add automated org-throttling-runbook step to policy-service (link: https://git.redwood/reviews/1234).

maya (on-call): :thumbsup: End.
